worked_solution:
Isolating the seventh-degree term, we find

$$
\begin{aligned}(3-x)^{7}-8 & \ge 5 \\ (3-x)^{7} & \ge 13.\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we take the seventh root of both sides and get

$$
\begin{aligned}\sqrt[7]{(3-x)^{7}} & \ge \sqrt[7]{13} \\ 3-x & \ge \sqrt[7]{13} \\ -x & \ge \sqrt[7]{13}-3 \\ x & \le -\sqrt[7]{13}+3.\end{aligned}
$$
